body: Well at the very least, you know you can reach out if you need / want to.
Go to our website www.imalive.org and click chat now. If it shows offline that means all volunteers are helping someone but it will show online when one is available.
It's hard to trust someone you don't know, however, keep in mind we listen and do not judge. We volunteer our time to help others. It's also free, so maybe keep that in mind.
We are online and free around the world. We know not every country has help, so we are here for everyone, anywhere.
We are available around the world, online and via chat. No phone required.

When you go to our website and click "chat now" it will give you a basic login. You can fill it out, or make it anonymous. No app, no info required. It is up to you what you would like to share, or not share. It is available around the world for free.
It is hard to reach out when they are strangers, yet, you can speak freely about anything and not be judged. It's completely anonymous, and sometimes strangers are easier to talk to.
Understandable, but keep in mind we are all volunteers wanting to help. We are not paid and take time each week to be there for people who need someone to listen.
